source.title: Object-Centric Learning with Slot Attention
source.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 34

confidence_rationale: Strong, widely-reproduced existence proof that a token-instance object-centric representation (a set of exchangeable 'slots' that competitively bind to objects) is learnable end-to-end and is the natural ML realization of the object-file / generalised z_object that ARC-080 proposes. Held below 0.8 by transfer risk: slot attention is unsupervised object discovery on image/CNN features, not drive/goal-coupled binding over REE's engineered latent streams, and a single-frame slot set does not by itself give cross-time permanence.
failure_signatures: Slot attention without a temporal/recurrent extension (e.g. SAVi) gives object-centric grouping WITHIN a frame but no token-instance persistence ACROSS occlusion -- so it grounds the binding/identity half of ARC-080 but not Pillar 1 (permanence) on its own.

Slots bind by competition over reconstruction of perceptual input; REE's z_object is detached from reconstruction and coupled to drive/goal value -- the binding pressure that makes slots specialise may be absent if REE supplies no comparable reconstruction or contrastive objective.

mapping.source_claim_statement: A set of exchangeable, randomly-initialised 'slots' can be made to bind to objects in a scene through iterative competitive attention over CNN features: each slot specialises to one object via a softmax-over-slots normalization that forces slots to compete for input. The result is an unsupervised, permutation-symmetric, object-centric representation that generalises to novel object counts and compositions, matching or beating prior unsupervised object-discovery methods while being faster and more memory-efficient.
mapping.ree_translation: Concrete ML existence proof for the core of ARC-080: that an OBJECT is a token-bound identity slot (not a category label) and that such token-instance slots are learnable end-to-end. Slot attention is the natural realization of the 'generalise z_object/z_resource from a type-tag store into a token-keyed object-file/binding layer' step the object-representation thread memo names as the first real substrate fork (type vs token vs anchor). The competitive softmax-over-slots is a candidate binding mechanism distinct from temporal synchrony -- relevant to MECH-045 (object-file buffers) and to whether REE's eventual object-file uses slot competition vs coherence.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Slot attention does unsupervised object discovery on images via CNN features and a reconstruction objective; REE's z_object is detached from reconstruction and coupled to SD-049/SD-057 drive/goal value, and REE's streams are engineered latents, not pixels. The binding pressure (reconstruction competition) that makes slots specialise has no current REE analog. And vanilla slot attention is single-frame -- token-instance PERSISTENCE through occlusion (ARC-080 Pillar 1) needs a recurrent extension (SAVi-class), so this supports the identity/binding half, not permanence.
mapping.source_context: Machine learning: unsupervised and supervised object discovery on synthetic visual datasets (CLEVR, Tetrominoes, multi-dSprites); architectural module between CNN features and a set-structured representation.

confidence_components.notes: High source quality (NeurIPS 2020, heavily reproduced, spawned a sub-field). Mapping fidelity good for the token-instance-binding existence claim. Transfer risk elevated: image/reconstruction-driven unsupervised discovery -> REE drive/goal-coupled latent streams, plus the single-frame-vs-persistence gap. This is grounding for buildability of the generalised z_object, not for REE's current substrate.
